name: Time Series Forecasting
description: Generate time series data, decompose trends and seasonality, and build a simple forecast.

cells.code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Generate synthetic daily metrics (e.g., website traffic)
np.random.seed(77)
days = 365 * 2  # 2 years of daily data
dates = pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=days, freq='D')

# Components: trend + seasonality + noise
trend = np.linspace(1000, 2500, days)
weekly_seasonal = 200 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.arange(days) / 7)
yearly_seasonal = 400 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.arange(days) / 365)
noise = np.random.normal(0, 100, days)

traffic = trend + weekly_seasonal + yearly_seasonal + noise
traffic = np.maximum(traffic, 0)  # No negative traffic

ts = pd.DataFrame({'date': dates, 'visitors': traffic.astype(int)})
ts = ts.set_index('date')

print(f"Time series: {len(ts)} days, from {ts.index[0].date()} to {ts.index[-1].date()}")
ts.describe()

# Plot the full time series
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))
plt.plot(ts.index, ts['visitors'], linewidth=0.5, color='#89b4fa', alpha=0.7)
plt.title('Daily Website Visitors (2 years)', color='white', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Date', color='#a6adc8')
plt.ylabel('Visitors', color='#a6adc8')
plt.tick_params(colors='#a6adc8')
plt.grid(alpha=0.15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Rolling averages to see trend
ts['ma_7'] = ts['visitors'].rolling(7).mean()
ts['ma_30'] = ts['visitors'].rolling(30).mean()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))
plt.plot(ts.index, ts['visitors'], alpha=0.3, color='#585b70', linewidth=0.5, label='Daily')
plt.plot(ts.index, ts['ma_7'], color='#89b4fa', linewidth=1.5, label='7-day MA')
plt.plot(ts.index, ts['ma_30'], color='#f9e2af', linewidth=2, label='30-day MA')
plt.title('Trend Analysis with Moving Averages', color='white', fontsize=14)
plt.legend()
plt.tick_params(colors='#a6adc8')
plt.grid(alpha=0.15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Monthly summary with year-over-year comparison
ts_monthly = ts['visitors'].resample('MS').agg(['mean', 'sum', 'std']).round(0)
ts_monthly.columns = ['avg_daily', 'total', 'std_dev']
ts_monthly['month'] = ts_monthly.index.month
ts_monthly['year'] = ts_monthly.index.year
ts_monthly

# Simple forecast: last 30-day average projected forward
last_30 = ts['visitors'].tail(30).mean()
growth_rate = (ts['ma_30'].iloc[-1] - ts['ma_30'].iloc[-90]) / 90  # daily growth

forecast_days = 90
forecast_dates = pd.date_range(ts.index[-1] + pd.Timedelta(days=1), periods=forecast_days)
forecast_values = [last_30 + growth_rate * i + 200 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * i / 7) for i in range(forecast_days)]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))
plt.plot(ts.index[-90:], ts['visitors'].tail(90), color='#89b4fa', linewidth=1, label='Actual')
plt.plot(forecast_dates, forecast_values, color='#a6e3a1', linewidth=2, linestyle='--', label='Forecast (90d)')
plt.axvline(ts.index[-1], color='#f9e2af', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7, label='Forecast start')
plt.fill_between(forecast_dates, 
                 [v - 150 for v in forecast_values],
                 [v + 150 for v in forecast_values],
                 alpha=0.1, color='#a6e3a1')
plt.title('90-Day Traffic Forecast', color='white', fontsize=14)
plt.legend()
plt.tick_params(colors='#a6adc8')
plt.grid(alpha=0.15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
